description: Make an edited copy of part of a public video (up to 15 s between start and end): vertical 9:16 or square crop, burned-in captions of the speech and of other sounds such as "[dog barking]" (in the language spoken, or translated to English, Portuguese, Spanish), even loudness; with an idea also AI-written text over the picture (thought bubbles, meme captions, a title), a dramatic zoom, and slow motion or speed-up. Describe the edit in idea, or set frame and captions_language (these override the idea). Returns a gimmeclip.com/w/… watch link kept for 30 days; if it returns an edit_id, call edit_video again with only that edit_id to keep waiting. Each new edit counts against the caller's 30 edits a day, and preparing the source against the daily download limit; repeating the same edit is free.

allow_ai_edit.description: Set true to allow a paid AI video change interpreted from the idea. Default false: the rest of the edit is still made.

captions_language.description: Burn in captions: "source" in the language spoken, or translated. Omit for no captions (unless the idea asks for them).

edit_id.description: Only to resume: edit_id from an earlier edit_video call that was still working.

end.description: Optional: end of the part to keep, in seconds (after start).

frame.description: "9:16" vertical (default), "1:1" square, "original", or any width:height from 2:5 to 5:2 ("4:5", "16:9").

idea.description: Optional: the edit in plain words, e.g. "15-second vertical with Portuguese captions".

item.description: Which video of a multi-video post (1-based); see get_video_info.

start.description: Optional: start of the part to keep, in seconds.

url.description: Link to a public post or video (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick).

name: edit_video
title: Make an edited clip
